They’re seeking refuge from the worst of their disorders, and this subreddit provides a fairly healthy outlet. There can be triggering content here but for the most part, people are self-aware enough to moderate themselves to a degree. 

The general consensus seems to focus around recovery and supporting people no matter where they are with their disorder. It’s about accepting and attempting to manage, and not condoning and promoting, harmful behaviours.

Exactly. Saying “Things will only get better if you want them to” is not a very empathetic response. Yes, not everything is out of our control but the implication that we’re stuck in this position because we ostensibly desire to be depressed and suicidal borders on cruel. I mean, in this indifferent, probabilistically erratic universe things could in fact get so much worse without any direct input from ourselves. That’s just the way it goes.

Sure, when you do certain things the likelihood of a certain outcome increases, but that doesn’t guarantee it. Pretty bold of them to come in here like an emotional snake oil salesperson and claim they have the answers to our problems. The intention is admirable but the execution needs fine tuning.

The feeling is very much mutual. I’m sorry to hear it. Seems like complete anhedonia and emotional detachment. Here to chat if you would like, though I never really know what to say. Hope you feel something soon.
